title: add benchmark-lab profiling baselines and reporting pipeline v23
author: Aisha Patel
description: Add profiling baselines and an opinionated reporting pipeline for Benchmark Lab (v23). Motivation: provide consistent cold/warm start baselines and automated reporting to detect regressions earlier in CI and nightly runs. This PR introduces workload runners for representative chat and completion workloads, standardized baseline JSON schema, CI integration for nightly profiling, and a lightweight reporting service that aggregates runs and publishes summary artifacts to S3 and the internal dashboard. Changes include data model updates, new runner binaries, orchestration workflows, and dashboards. Checklist: 1) add representative workload runners for chat and generation; 2) implement profiling baseline collector and schema; 3) wire nightly CI job + artifact upload; 4) add reporting pipeline and dashboard ingest; 5) add tests and perf checks; 6) document usage and runbook. Backwards compatibility: the baseline schema is additive and older tooling will ignore new optional fields. See related PRs pr-56042 and pr-57891 for previous iterations. This is intended to be a safe, incremental rollout: default nightly jobs are gated to the benchmark lab namespace and the reporting pipeline will not be enabled for production until configured. Release notes: adds profiling baselines and reporting pipeline for Benchmark Lab v23 to improve regression detection and visibility.

release_notes: Adds Benchmark Lab v23: representative workload runners, standardized profiling baseline schema (v2), nightly profiling CI job, and a reporting pipeline that publishes aggregated summaries to S3 and the internal dashboard.
testing_summary: Unit tests added for schema validation and ingest retry logic. End-to-end bench-e2e-smoke verifies runners can produce baseline JSON and CI artifact upload script validates s3 write. Manual run of nightly profiling on staging completed with expected artifact generation and dashboard ingestion.
rollout_plan: Rollout in three phases: 1) merge to main and enable in staging (BENCHMARK_LAB_NIGHTLY=true) for 1 week; 2) enable nightly in benchmark lab namespace for engineering org and observe cost/volume for 2 weeks; 3) opt-in for production teams via README and helm values. Monitor cost and ingestion error rates; automatic rollback if error rate >1% for 24h.
